info.additionalInfo:
A Dreamy TV Girl-inspired Roblox theme wrapped in electric pink, deep blue and midnight black — nostalgic, romantic and beautifully bittersweet. >⩊<

⋆.˚  Release Notes ⋆.˚

- ✦ Full TV Girl-inspired visual overhaul for Roblox.

- ✦ Added the signature electric pink, deep blue and midnight black color palette.

- ✦ Restyled navigation, sidebar, buttons and interface accents.

- ✦ Improved visual consistency across the Roblox home page.

- ✦ Added stronger contrast to better match the classic TV Girl aesthetic.

- ✦ Refined small UI details for a cleaner, more cohesive look.

- ✦ General polish and compatibility improvements.
